goal: FIRST DONE: one startup-authorized GATHER job autonomously dispatches five farm marches for one visible ROK character using the pair auto-filled by each fresh New Troop screen, with verified queue transitions from 0/5 to 5/5.
constraints: Root model is selected by the user in the current session; role model and effort are resolved dynamically per assignment, not pinned in repository policy.

FIRST DONE targets one character and one five-march round with fresh per-march queue verification and no per-march manual approval. Return/refill, buff continuity and 24-hour endurance are later milestones.
Team configuration never grants live input, mission ticks, model endpoint calls, model-server changes or account action; these require separate task-specific authority and evidence.
Use the graph completion ladder: planned behavior and offline tests never promote live, repeatable or stable claims.
ROOT alone maintains docs/ROOT.md; worker records stay under workspace/agents/<package>/<role>/. Every writer receives explicit files and disjoint graph ownership.
Read-only roles return reports without editing. No child delegation unless explicitly assigned and within both repo and runtime limits.
Coordinate by completion/blocker events, not polling or sleep-and-retry.
fallback: Stop the unavailable role and report to root; root may continue in its current model. No automatic model/account/reset change.
